temporal_state_chain.observed: Elizabeth has been unusually curt with him over the past few days; when he asks if he upset her, she says no and explains she is dealing with personal stuff, apologizing if she seemed short.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Elizabeth might be upset with him, possibly because of a misunderstanding or an unknown mistake he made.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Elizabeth directly denies being upset with him and attributes her behavior to personal stress, so his suspicion that he caused her curtness is corrected.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Elizabeth is not angry with him; she is dealing with personal stress.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To be understanding and consider offering support if she wants it.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Elizabeth accepts his offer of a coffee break and says his kindness means a lot.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Elizabeth is not upset with him and is dealing with personal stress; she may need support.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Elizabeth is receptive to his support and agrees to spend time together, suggesting she trusts him enough to accept help.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Elizabeth is willing to accept his support and talk over a coffee break.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To listen and offer support during the coffee break.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Over coffee, Elizabeth shares more about her stresses, which seem severe; when he suggests professional help, she says she has thought about it but is hesitant and unsure.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Elizabeth is dealing with personal stress and has accepted his support; he does not yet know how severe it is.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Elizabeth's stress appears severe, and professional help may benefit her; she is not rejecting the idea outright but is hesitant.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Elizabeth is under significant stress and is hesitant about seeking professional help, though she has considered it.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Concerned and uncertain about whether he overstepped.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To support her without pressuring her and to respect her hesitation.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Elizabeth becomes slightly withdrawn after his professional-help suggestion; when he apologizes for overstepping, she says he did not overstep, appreciates his concern, and says it is just a lot to think about.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Elizabeth is hesitant about professional help, and Keith is worried his suggestion may have been too forward.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Her withdrawal made him think he may have embarrassed or overstepped, but her reassurance corrects this; she appreciates his concern while still processing.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: His suggestion did not offend Elizabeth; she values his concern but is still thinking through a lot.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Regretful, then reassured but still concerned.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To remain supportive without pushing and to reassure her that he is there for her.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Elizabeth seems more open and appreciative; she says his support means a lot and that she feels better knowing she has it.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Elizabeth appreciates his concern but is still processing a lot; he hopes to remain supportive.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Elizabeth confirms that she values his support and feels more comfortable and better because of it.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Elizabeth values his support, feels more comfortable around him, and their supportive relationship is positive.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To maintain the supportive relationship and remain available to chat or take breaks together.
